title: A companion's 'near leaving' state is warned in flavor text (Tamsin: 'One more like that and I'm gone. I don't give second warnings, only first ones.') but neither her dialogue nor `status` ever states the actual threshold (an absolute regard floor? a second strike?) at which she would actually depart the party.
where: status / Tamsin dialogue after the barrow-doors quarrel
